claims.evidence: Run names <date>_<cell line>_<C|M|N|V|Mitos|Vesicles>_<1|2>_<slice>.raw; MaxQuant experimentalDesignTemplate assigns each 10-file set to one experiment (A549 C_3/C_4, M_3/M_4, N_3/N_4, V_3/V_4 for file replicates 1/2; Calu-1 C_C_1..C_V_2; NCI-H1299 H_C_1..H_V_2). Each mixture holds three physical samples: the heavy infected compartment, the medium control compartment and one aliquot of the light internal standard (paper: "all light-labeled cell fractions of one experiment were combined and served as an internal standard. This standard was spiked in 1:2 ratio into the mixed compartment fractions"), so each light standard - one physical pool per (cell line, experiment) - is spiked into four mixtures. It is encoded as one source name per mixture (24 mixtures x 3 = 72 source names; 6 physical light pools); all four names of a pool carry identical characteristics and the experiment's biological replicate number. The spec allows one source name for a reused sample (README.adoc: "it can be present multiple times if the same sample is used several times in the same dataset"), but that encoding repeats (source, biological replicate, technical replicate, fraction) across four runs and is refused by sdrf-tools build (check_coordinates) and sdrf-tools structure (duplicate-row-coordinate); skills/sdrf-annotate/references/validation.md:22-23 prescribes one source name per run for a shared reference. Open: independent review round 2 F1 asks for one name per pool (54 sources); needs a maintainer decision on the tooling rule.

claims.value: SILAC heavy (Arg10/Lys8) = IAV-infected; SILAC medium (Arg6/Lys4) = uninfected control; SILAC light (Arg0/Lys0) = uninfected internal standard
claims.evidence: Paper Fig. 2A legend: "SILAC-labeled A549, Calu-1 and NCI-H1299 cells were IAV infected for 24 h (Arg10/Lys8) with a MOI of 2 or left untreated (Arg6/Lys4 and Arg0/Lys0)"; text: "medium-heavy labeled control and heavy labeled IAV infected cells were subsequently combined in a 1:1 ratio". Deposit readme.txt: "Light is the internal control spiked into all samples comparing IVA (heavy) versus control (medium heavy) compartments." summary.txt: all 240 files Multiplicity 3, Labels1 Arg6;Lys4, Labels2 Arg10;Lys8. Data check: all 10 influenza protein groups are heavy-dominant in all 24 experiments (median log2 normalized H/M 2.7-4.7 per experiment); interferon-stimulated IFIT1/IFIT2/OASL H/M 2-15 in all A549 compartments (paper: IFITs significantly up "exclusively in A549").

Paper Methods: "influenza virus strain X:31 A/AICHI/68 (Charles River ...) ... at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 2 PFU per cell ... for 24 h". NCBITaxon:132504 label "Influenza A virus (A/X-31(H3N2))" (not obsolete). PRIDE organism NEWT:553341 is "Influenza A virus (A/Aichi/68/2007(H3N2))", a 2007 isolate that does not match the 1968-derived X-31 reassortant named in the paper, so it was not used. Custom characteristics column (spec "Extending Templates"); the pathogen is not a characteristics[organism] of the host samples.

claims.evidence: File token _1_/_2_ and MaxQuant experiments (A549 *_3/*_4 = files _1_/_2_; Calu-1 and NCI-H1299 *_1/*_2) are the two biological replicates per cell line ("Analyzed are vesicles (V), mitochondria (M), cytosol (C), and nuclei (N), each in two biological replicates"; paper: "We minimally analyzed two biological replicates from all conditions"). Each replicate is a separately labelled, infected and fractionated culture set; the four compartments of one replicate derive from the same culture and share its number. The paper's third A549 replicate (Fig. 2B n = 3) is not in this deposit (MaxQuant experiments C_1/C_2, M_1/M_2... with 2012 LTQ Orbitrap XL runs belong to companion PXD007809).

claims.location: factor value[infection] rows of SILAC light
claims.evidence: The light channel is the internal standard (reference), not a level of the compared variable; characteristics[infection] keeps the true value uninfected.

Raw headers of A549, NCI-H1299 and Calu-1 files: "Q Exactive Plus" / "Q Exactive Plus - Orbitrap MS"; paper: "EasyLC 1000 nanoflow-HPLC connected online to a QExactive Plus". PRIDE instruments and MaxQuant summary Instrument say "Q Exactive" (MaxQuant 1.4 does not distinguish the Plus); the raw header is more specific and is used.

claims.location: comment[proteomics data acquisition method] + comment[dissociation method] + comment[collision energy] + comment[ms2 mass analyzer] rows 1-720
claims.evidence: Paper: "Mass spectrometers were operated in the data-dependent mode ... For QExactive Plus analyses: after each MS scan ... a maximum of ten MS/MS scans were performed using a normalized collision energy of 25%, ... resolution of 17,500" (Orbitrap MS2, HCD on a Q Exactive Plus).
Paper: in-gel digestion with "trypsin (MS grade, Promega)". MaxQuant search rule Trypsin/P, 3 missed cleavages (summary.txt Enzyme Trypsin/P; batch rule 2: SDRF records the digestion enzyme).

Paper: "Proteins were separated by SDS-PAGE using 4-12% Bis-Tris gels ... Gel lanes were cut into 10 slices". comment[fraction identifier] = the MaxQuant experimentalDesignTemplate Fraction value. For A549 and NCI-H1299 it equals the file-name slice index; for all 80 Calu-1 files MaxQuant uses 11 - index (file _1 = fraction 10). The deposited search numbering is kept, and it follows gel order in all three cell lines: median protein MW of the PSMs (mwcheck) falls from fraction 1 to fraction 10 for A549 (file index 1-10: 117-149 -> 19 kDa) and NCI-H1299 (191 -> 24 kDa), and for Calu-1, whose file index runs the other way (27 -> 238 kDa), MaxQuant fraction 1 = file index 10 = 238 kDa. Fraction k is therefore the same gel region (high MW first) in every cell line.
Paper: "reduced with 1 mm DTT for 10 min at 95 C and alkylated using 5.5 mm iodoacetamide".

limitations: comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.4.1.2 parameters.txt/summary.txt do not record the first/main-search precursor tolerance and no mqpar.xml was deposited (paper states only post-recalibration precision <1 ppm). parse_sdrf convert-openms therefore fails on this column.
The PRIDE organism NEWT:553341 (A/Aichi/68/2007) disagrees with the paper strain (X:31 A/AICHI/68 = reassortant on 1968 Aichi HA/NA); NCBITaxon:132504 A/X-31(H3N2) used from the paper.

Companion PXD007809 (not annotated here): the paper reports three A549 compartment replicates, this deposit holds two. The 132 runs of this deposit's joint MaxQuant design that are absent here (2012 AZ_fractions, 2013 WCL; MaxQuant experiments C_1/C_2, M_1/M_2, N_1/N_2, V_1/V_2, WCL) are in PXD007809 and no RAW file is shared (385 RAW 2008-2013 there; per the independent review's listing, not re-fetched by the producer). readme: "This project is an addition to the project PXD007809"; paper Data Availability lists both. Not a duplicate. If PXD007809 is annotated, coordinate A549 replicate numbers: here 1/2 = MaxQuant C_3/C_4 etc.

MOI 2 PFU/cell and the 24 h infection duration are stated in the paper but not encoded: no template column for MOI, and characteristics[sampling time] (sample-metadata: time-course sampling point) would imply a time course and an artificial infected/control asymmetry (independent review round 2, minor F3), so the column was dropped. Both values are recorded here only.
characteristics[passage number] and characteristics[individual] = not available: no passage number or donor identifier is given in any source.
